meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Emil Kowalski 的设计工程理念来帮你打磨界面。它评审 UI 代码时会同时给出「改进前/改进后」的对照表格,并严格按动画频率、目的、缓动、时长等框架给出建议。
howto.when: 当你说出「帮我优化界面」「评审这段 UI 代码」,或询问动画、交互细节(如缓动、时长、transform-origin)时,技能就会启动。

say.text: 帮我评审这段按钮动画,给出 Before/After 改进建议
say.note: Claude 会按表格逐条分析并给出优化后的代码。

say.text: 下拉菜单的动画应该用多大的时长和什么缓动?
say.note: 它会按框架给出具体数值和曲线。

say.text: 这个弹窗应该从哪里缩放出现?

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude applies Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy to UI work. When reviewing UI code, it outputs a Before/After markdown table and follows a framework for animation frequency, purpose, easing, and duration.
howto.when_en: The skill activates when you ask Claude to help with interface design, review UI code, or discuss animation/interaction details such as easing, duration, or transform-origin.

say_en.text: Review this button animation and suggest Before/After improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze row by row and provide optimized code.

say_en.text: What easing and duration should I use for a dropdown animation?
say_en.note: It will give specific values and curves from its framework.

say_en.text: Where should this popover scale from?
say_en.note: It will explain transform-origin and provide CSS.
